assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with the blue cevians AD, BE and CF; their pairwise intersections P, Q, R are the midpoints of AD, BE and CF, and the central triangle PQR is shaded orange.

difficulty_rationale: Needs three applications of Menelaus' theorem, an argument that the cyclic system forces equal ratios (the golden ratio), and an area decomposition into three triangles plus the central one.
